$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. One MCP tool per operation of driver/PROTOCOL.md section 4. Each tool takes the client to use and the operation's arguments, passes them to the client's adapter unchanged, and returns its response: {ok: true, result} or {ok: false, error: {kind, message, status?, ...}}. A param whose value is a string naming a def ("$def") takes that def's schema; its own description, when given, replaces the def's.

etag.description: An entity tag, verbatim: quotes and W/ included.

body.description: The request body, one of: {"text": string} (UTF-8), {"base64": string} (bytes), {"json": any} (serialized; the content type defaults to application/json).

patch.description: A JSON Patch (RFC 6902) operations array. The client rebuilds it with its own JsonPatch builder and sends it as application/json-patch+json.

query.description: An application/lws-query+json filter: keys are "type" or a relation IRI, each a list of AND groups, where a group is an IRI or a list of IRIs (an OR group). {} matches everything.

limit.description: Return at most this many (default 1000); truncated says whether there were more.

document.description: A JSON-LD document, as the specification shows it.

operations.name: discover_storage
operations.title: Discover a storage
operations.description: Find the storage a resource belongs to: HEAD the resource, follow its Link rel="https://www.w3.org/ns/lws#storage", and read the storage description. Returns the description's id, types, storage root, services and verification methods, and the raw document.

operations.name: get_storage_description
operations.title: Read a storage description
operations.description: Read a storage description directly, by the storage's URL.

operations.name: head
operations.title: HEAD a resource
operations.description: Send HEAD to a resource and return its metadata: status, ETag, content type, links (linkset, up, type, storage), Allow and Accept-Patch.

operations.name: read
operations.title: Read a resource
operations.description: GET a resource. Returns its metadata, whether it was not modified (a 304 to ifNoneMatch), the Content-Range of a range request, and the body: {text} for textual types, {base64} otherwise.

rangeStart.description: The first byte of a range request.

rangeEnd.description: The last byte of a range request, inclusive.

ifNoneMatch.description: Read only if the ETag changed.

operations.name: read_container
operations.title: Read a container page
operations.description: GET a container as application/lws+json: its id, types, totalItems, the items on this page, and the first/next/prev/last page links.

url.description: The container, or a page URL the storage gave.

operations.name: list_container
operations.title: List a container
operations.description: List a container's members, following its next links page by page.

operations.name: create
operations.title: Create a resource
operations.description: POST a new data resource into a container. Returns its Location and the metadata of the 201.

container.description: The container to create it in.

contentType.description: Its media type; text defaults to text/plain, base64 to application/octet-stream, json to application/json.

slug.description: A name hint, sent as Slug.

types.description: Extra type IRIs, sent as Link rel="type".

links.description: Extra links to send, as Link headers.

operations.name: create_container
operations.title: Create a container
operations.description: POST a new container into a container, with Link: <https://www.w3.org/ns/lws#Container>; rel="type".

parent.description: The container to create it in.

slug.description: A name hint, sent as Slug.

operations.name: update
operations.title: Replace a resource
operations.description: PUT a data resource's new content. Returns the status, the new ETag and the metadata.

ifMatch.description: Replace only if the ETag still matches.

operations.name: patch
operations.title: Patch a resource
operations.description: PATCH a JSON resource with a JSON Patch.

ifMatch.description: Patch only if the ETag still matches.

operations.name: delete
operations.title: Delete a resource
operations.description: DELETE a resource. A non-empty container needs recursive, which sends Depth: infinity.

recursive.description: Delete a container with everything in it.

ifMatch.description: Delete only if the ETag still matches.

operations.name: linkset_url
operations.title: Find a linkset
operations.description: Find a resource's linkset through its Link rel="linkset".

operations.name: read_linkset
operations.title: Read a linkset
operations.description: Find and read a resource's linkset (RFC 9264). Returns its URL, ETag, the document, and its Allow and Accept-Patch.

operations.name: update_linkset
operations.title: Replace a linkset
operations.description: PUT a linkset's new document, as application/linkset+json.

linksetUrl.description: The linkset's URL, from linkset_url or read_linkset.

operations.name: patch_linkset
operations.title: Patch a linkset
operations.description: PATCH a linkset with a JSON Patch on its document, such as add /linkset/0/describedby.

operations.name: subscribe
operations.title: Subscribe to notifications
operations.description: Subscribe to webhook notifications about some resources. The inbox defaults to the client's own, from open_inbox.

serviceUrl.description: The notification service's endpoint, from the storage description.

expires.description: When the subscription should end, RFC 3339.

operations.name: list_subscriptions
operations.title: List subscriptions
operations.description: List the subscriptions of a notification service.

operations.name: get_subscription
operations.title: Read a subscription
operations.description: Read a subscription.

operations.name: unsubscribe
operations.title: Unsubscribe
operations.description: Delete a subscription.

operations.name: verify_notification
operations.title: Verify a notification
operations.description: Verify a webhook delivery with the client's WebhookVerifier (RFC 9421 signature, Content-Digest, the storage's published key) and parse its notification. Deliveries to the client's own inbox are verified this way already; see inbox_deliveries.

url.description: The inbox URL as it was registered.

headers.description: Every header field, name to list of values.

trustedStorages.description: Accept notifications from these storages only.

operations.name: request_access
operations.title: Request access
operations.description: POST an access request to an access request service. Returns its Location.

request.description: The AccessRequest: @context, type, storage, access policies, inbox.

operations.name: get_access_request
operations.title: Read an access request
operations.description: Read an access request.

operations.name: list_access_requests
operations.title: List access requests
operations.description: List the requests of an access request service.

operations.name: cancel_access_request
operations.title: Cancel an access request
operations.description: Delete an access request.

operations.name: grant_access
operations.title: Grant access
operations.description: POST an access grant to an access grant service. Returns its Location.

grant.description: The AccessGrant: @context, type, storage, access policies.

operations.name: get_access_grant
operations.title: Read an access grant
operations.description: Read an access grant.

operations.name: list_access_grants
operations.title: List access grants
operations.description: List the grants of an access grant service.

operations.name: revoke_access_grant
operations.title: Revoke an access grant
operations.description: Delete an access grant.

operations.name: read_type_index
operations.title: Read the type index
operations.description: Read a page of a type index: the types and the page links.

url.description: The TypeIndexService endpoint, or a page URL it gave.

operations.name: list_types
operations.title: List indexed types
operations.description: List every type a type index holds, following its pages.

operations.name: search_types
operations.title: Search by type
operations.description: Search a type search service with HTTP QUERY (application/lws-query+json) and return the first page of results.

operations.name: search_all
operations.title: Search by type, every page
operations.description: Search a type search service and follow the results' next links.

operations.name: accepted_query_formats
operations.title: Query formats
operations.description: Ask a type search service, with OPTIONS, which query formats it accepts (Accept-Query).
